extension.description: Shows Module Federation microfrontend status for the open workspace.
viewContainer.title: MF Dashboard
view.title: MF Dashboard
configuration.title: MF Dashboard
configuration.language: Language of tree labels and details. auto follows VS Code. en and ru set the language explicitly.
configuration.structure: tree nests a remote under the microfrontend that uses it. flat lists every microfrontend on its own.
configuration.ignorePaths: Extra directories skipped while scanning for Module Federation configs.
configuration.extraManifestUrls: Manifest URLs that have no application in this workspace.
configuration.packageManager: auto reads the repository package manager. npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun are explicit.
configuration.probeIntervalMs: Milliseconds between port, manifest, and zip checks.
configuration.typesSettleMs: Milliseconds after a source save before a zip is treated as stale.
configuration.types.autoCheck: Automatically check type files, producer sources, and types ZIP archives. When disabled, ports and manifests still update; use Check @mf-types to check types manually.
configuration.terminal.reveal: Show the terminal when Start runs a script.
configuration.scripts.start: package.json script key used by Start. The default is dev.
configuration.commands.rebuildTypes: Command that replaces dts generation. Empty uses the plugin. Placeholders: {folder}, {name}, {port}, {tsconfig}.
configuration.commands.refetchTypes: Command that replaces the types download. Empty downloads the zip. Placeholder: {typesFolder}.
configuration.apps: Known microfrontends. Discovery adds missing names and does not rewrite existing entries.
configuration.apps.configFile: Optional build config path relative to the app folder. Takes precedence over the start script's config path.
configuration.apps.typesZipPath: ZIP produced by the custom rebuild command. Relative paths are resolved from the application folder. Defaults to the path read from the build config.
